law_name: Law No. 2000/011 of 19 December 2000 on Copyright and Neighbouring Rights
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (collective, audiovisual, applied-art, anonymous and pseudonymous works: 50 years from creation or publication; posthumous works: 50 years from publication)
digital_protection: Fraudulent neutralisation of effective technical measures treated as infringement
fair_use_exceptions: Statutory exceptions (quotation, teaching, parody, press review, private copying levy)
